$comment: VENDORED copy of the normative kiosk.tech schema at spec/schemas/discovery.schema.json. It is here so e2e/schema_conformance.rb can validate this origin's LIVE wire bytes against the PUBLISHED schema with no second checkout and no network fetch. Identical to the upstream copy as PARSED JSON once this $comment is removed.
title: Kiosk discovery document
description: The JSON served at GET /.well-known/kiosk.json (Kiosk protocol 0.5).

version.description: Discovery-document FORMAT version (currently "1.0"), independent of the protocol version.

issuer.description: The AP2 mandate iss anchor and the token iss/aud. An absolute https URL.

endpoint.description: The wire-verb root (base URL + mount path), e.g. https://example.com/kiosk.

capabilities.description: The modules this endpoint serves, from the canonical set, in canonical order. Only this list publishes the modules; the verb names are in the catalog at `schema_url`.

schema_url.description: Where to fetch the catalog: the same document as the unauthenticated GET <endpoint>/schema. It MAY carry a version parameter; then the operator MUST change it when the catalog changes, and MAY serve that URL as immutable.

owner.description: Provider-chosen contact info; SHOULD include at least an email.

skill.description: Pinned skill reference. Omitted entirely when no skill is pinned.

url.description: A versioned, immutable skill URL on kiosk.tech (skill-vX.Y.Z.md). An assistant refuses a skill on any other host.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the skill file content.

events_url.description: Where to open the event stream. Present IFF `capabilities` carries `events`. An absolute wss:// URL -- the same origin and mount as `endpoint` under the WebSocket scheme, never a second copy of the host.
